en.title: Who Counts the Lies in the Gray City?
en.premise: A woman visits a detective whose life is steeped in cheap liquor and cigarette smoke. She isn't looking for a person, but an obsolete AI that gained self-awareness and vanished into the city. As I pursue the truth behind the 'loneliness' felt by a machine, a small crack begins to form in my own frozen heart.

zh.title: 灰色的城市中，谁在数着谎言
zh.premise: 一位女性拜访了一名终日沉溺于廉价酒精与烟雾中的侦探。她寻找的并非人类，而是一个产生了自我意识并逃往城市的旧型人工智能。在追寻机器心中那份“孤独”的真相时，我那颗冰封的心，也悄然出现了一道细小的裂痕。
